title: Cassette-CMF Blocks configuration
description: IDE-tooling schema for the array/JSON shape accepted by CassetteCMFBlocks::register_from_array()/register_from_json(). This is documentation only — the runtime validator is Json\Block_Schema_Validator, which reads valid control types from Schema\Control_Catalog::get_registered_types() and valid areas from Schema\Area_Resolver::known_areas() at run time, and is authoritative when the two disagree. "type" is deliberately left as an open string here rather than a closed enum, precisely because the parent library's own schema.json hardcodes such an enum and has drifted out of sync with its runtime validator as a result — see this repository's CHANGELOG.md and docs/RELEASE.md. This file covers only what is implemented so far.

editor_scope.description: Compiled into a single allowed_block_types_all filter. See docs/block-config-reference.md.

content.description: Raw WordPress comment-delimited block HTML. Wins over "blocks" when both are present.

blocks.description: A declarative { blockName, attrs, innerBlocks } tree, serialized into the same shape "content" would be.

args.description: Verbatim block.json-shaped passthrough: title, category, icon, keywords, parent, ancestor, allowedBlocks, supports, styles, variations, selectors, blockHooks, usesContext, providesContext, example, textdomain, apiVersion. Block_Definition translates the camelCase keys among these to the snake_case properties WP_Block_Type actually reads. apiVersion defaults to 3 and supports.html defaults to false for dynamic blocks when not set.

attributes.description: Pure-data attributes with no control: name => WP attribute schema ({type, default, enum, ...}). Merged with field-derived attributes; a name collision between the two is an error.

render.description: "mode": "dynamic" (default), "static", or "none". See docs/markup-templates.md and docs/static-save.md for "markup"/"callback"/"template"/"deprecated", not fully re-modeled here yet.

document_scope.description: Required whenever a field resolves to the document/document.status/document.excerpt/document.publish.pre/document.publish.post/sidebar/more_menu area. See docs/block-config-reference.md.

name.description: Must be unique among all value-bearing fields in the block — they share one flat block-attribute namespace.

type.description: Control type. Validated at runtime against Control_Catalog::get_registered_types(), not against a closed list here.

cmf_type.description: Optional override of which parent field type provides sanitize()/validate() reuse via Compat\Cmf_Bridge.

area.description: Dot-notation "<surface>[.<group>]", e.g. "inspector.styles", "toolbar.block", "canvas". Inherited from the nearest enclosing container when omitted; defaults to "inspector" at the top level. Validated against Area_Resolver::known_areas().

source.description: "attribute" (the default) produces a block attribute; "meta" registers real post/term/user/comment meta (see docs/meta-binding.md) and requires a "meta" config. "context"/"none" are recognised and excluded from the attribute schema, but "context" has no read/write wiring yet.

meta.description: Only meaningful when "source" is "meta". See docs/meta-binding.md.

value_type.description: Overrides the control type's inferred WP attribute schema type.

options.description: value => label map, matching the parent library's convention. Produces an "enum" of the option keys in the attribute schema.

enum.description: Explicit enum, used when "options" isn't a natural fit for the control.

role.description: WP attribute "role" (e.g. "content"), passed through when set.

fields.description: Child fields, for container control types (panel, tab_panel, group, row, stack, toolbar_group, repeater).
